item.tib: du tri su zhi gcod kyi sgrub pa'i nyams len gsal 'debs rkang brda'i glu dbyangs
item.coloph: de ltar zhi gcod nyams len 'khyer bde bas/ phyogs dngul me long 'dir bkod pas/ nongs mchis lha dang bla ma'i spyan sngar bshags/ lha grogs shes bstan yid dga'i 'dzum gsus shig 'dir 'byung dge ba'i 'gal (bas 'ga') la phan srid na/ srid bde'i phun tshogs rngan pa'i rgya mthong ste/ ri dwags rmas bzhin gcig bsgrab dben khrod rir/ rim gnyis rnal 'byor ngang rings sku gsum gyis (gyi/)'bras smin bstan 'gro'i dga' ston 'gyed nus shog/
